description: This is the main activity class for an Android application demonstrating a simple UI with fragment management, logging, and menu options.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class handling fragment transactions, menu interactions, and logging setup for an Android app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets content view, and adds a fragment if activity is created for the first time.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu by setting visibility and title of menu items depending on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, particularly toggling the log view visibility.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with custom log wrappers and fragments, and logs readiness.
